claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mocetinostat is a class I HDAC inhibitor whose antiproliferative/killing effect at 2.5 uM is driven by HDAC inhibition, producing broad but modest cytotoxicity across many cancer lineages rather than a single lineage-selective effect.
